Address: 7003 Steeles Ave. W Unit 10, Etobicoke, Ontario M9W 0A2 (HQ — multiple offices across BC, Alberta, Manitoba, and Ontario; see https://www.punjabinsurance.ca/contact.php for full locations)
Languages: English
ServiceRegions: British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Ontario (Travel and Super Visa products available Canada-wide)

# Punjab Insurance Overview
Punjab Insurance Inc. is a leading Canadian insurance broker established in 2006, dedicated to helping families and businesses access the best insurance and investment solutions. The company specializes in Super Visa Insurance, Life Insurance, RDSP, and a wide range of investment and health plans. Punjab Insurance offers personalized, culturally sensitive advice tailored to newcomers, immigrants, seniors, and business owners across Canada. The company holds a Google rating of 4.5 stars and has served 20,000+ customers.

InsurerPartners: Allianz, GMS, RSA, Tugo, Travelance, Sun Life Financial (and others — see https://www.punjabinsurance.ca/companies-we-represent.php for full list)
GoogleBusiness: https://g.page/punjabinsurance
Licensing: Regulated under provincial insurance standards; licensed in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, and Ontario (FSRA regulated in Ontario)

## Key Features
- **Free Online Quotes**: Instant, no-obligation insurance quotes available directly on the website.
- **Online Rate Comparison**: Side-by-side plan comparison tools for Super Visa and visitor insurance.
- **Insurance Calculators**: Tools for estimating coverage needs across life, health, travel, mortgage, disability, and retirement.
- **Multilingual Support**: Advisors speak multiple languages to serve immigrant and newcomer communities.
- **Personalized Consultation**: One-on-one guidance to help users select the right plan for their needs and budget.
- **Schedule a Call**: Users can book a callback directly from the website.
- **Blog & Learning Center**: Educational articles covering insurance topics to help users make informed decisions.
- **FAQ Section**: Detailed answers to common questions across all product categories.

## Trust & Credentials
- Established in 2006 with 20+ years of experience serving Canadian families and businesses.
- Google Rating of 4.5 stars with 20,000+ satisfied customers.
- Represents major Canadian insurers including Allianz, GMS, RSA, Tugo, and Travelance.
- Regulated under Canadian insurance standards; partner insurers backed by Canadian government re-insurance.

## Products & Services
- **Life Insurance**: Term, Whole, Universal, Permanent, and Non-Medical life insurance plans.
- **Super Visa Insurance**: Affordable insurance plans for parents and grandparents visiting Canada.
- **Critical Illness Insurance**: Lump sum payout on diagnosis of major illnesses.
- **Disability Insurance**: Income protection if unable to work due to injury or illness.
- **Health & Emergency Medical Insurance**: Comprehensive health coverage for individuals and families.
- **RDSP**: Registered Disability Savings Plan with up to $90,000 in government grants and bonds.
- **Travel Insurance**: Emergency medical and trip protection for Canadians travelling abroad.
- **Visitor Insurance**: Health coverage for visitors coming to Canada.
- **Mortgage Insurance**: Protection for homeowners in case of unforeseen events.
- **Investment Plans**: RRSP, TFSA, RESP, RRSP Loan, and Buy-Sell Agreements.
